note: Best-effort curated mapping of detected technology names to likely upstream license metadata. Classifications should be verified against upstream projects before making policy claims.

Drupal.notes: Drupal core is licensed under GPL-2.0-or-later.

WordPress.notes: WordPress core is licensed under GPL-2.0-or-later.

jQuery.notes: jQuery is distributed under the MIT License.

jQuery UI.notes: jQuery UI is distributed under the MIT License.

jQuery Migrate.notes: jQuery Migrate is distributed under the MIT License.

Bootstrap.notes: Bootstrap is distributed under the MIT License.

React.notes: React is distributed under the MIT License.

Angular.notes: AngularJS is MIT-licensed, while newer Angular releases use Apache-2.0; treat this generic detection as best-effort.

Vue.js.notes: Vue.js is distributed under the MIT License.

Google Analytics.notes: Google Analytics is a proprietary hosted analytics service, not a single distributable software package.

Google Tag Manager.notes: Google Tag Manager is a proprietary hosted service, not a single distributable software package.

Cloudflare.notes: Cloudflare is primarily a proprietary CDN and DDoS mitigation service; package SPDX classification does not cleanly apply.

Akamai.notes: Akamai is primarily a proprietary CDN and edge service; package SPDX classification does not cleanly apply.

Nginx.notes: Open source Nginx uses the BSD-2-Clause license.

Apache.notes: Apache HTTP Server is distributed under Apache-2.0.

PHP.notes: PHP is distributed under the PHP License v3.01, which is OSI-approved.

MySQL.notes: MySQL Community Server is GPL-2.0-only, with separate commercial licensing also available.

Yoast SEO.notes: Yoast SEO is distributed under GPL-3.0-or-later.

reCAPTCHA.notes: Google reCAPTCHA is a proprietary hosted service.

Windows Server.notes: Windows Server is proprietary Microsoft server software.

IIS.notes: Internet Information Services is proprietary software bundled with Windows Server.

Microsoft ASP.NET.notes: ASP.NET Core is MIT-licensed, while legacy ASP.NET components were proprietary; treat this generic detection as medium confidence.

Font Awesome.notes: Font Awesome combines MIT code, OFL-1.1 fonts, and CC-BY-4.0 assets, so the generic detection is mixed rather than a single OSI-approved package license.

jsDelivr.notes: The jsDelivr platform code is MIT-licensed, but the CDN serves packages under many different upstream licenses.

Slick.notes: Slick carousel is distributed under the MIT License.

Leaflet.notes: Leaflet is distributed under the BSD-2-Clause license.

Modernizr.notes: Modernizr is distributed under the MIT License.

OWL Carousel.notes: OWL Carousel is distributed under the MIT License.

Varnish.notes: Varnish Cache is distributed under Apache-2.0.

Google Font API.notes: Google Font API is a hosted font delivery service rather than a single distributable software package.

Cart Functionality.notes: Cart Functionality is a generic detection category, not a single upstream package.
